depiction.primary_object: downward-pointing arrow inside a thick circular outline
depiction.composition: single centered symbol, flat front view

readings.meaning: download or save for offline use

ambiguity: Easily confused with generic UI navigation buttons (scroll down, expand accordion) or other download icons that include a tray or cloud.

modifier_semantics.meaning: encapsulates the arrow as an action button, commonly signifying media or file download

task_intents: reduce or lower a recurring metric

reasoning: A downward arrow in a circle is the standard symbol for downloading media or files for offline use in many apps, though it also serves as generic directional UI chrome. It fits tasks centered on downloading files, installers, or offline content, but is less distinctive than a download arrow over a tray or out of a cloud.
